recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not edit current Medication source for this DSTU1 issue; any cleanup of stale, unreferenced package-form value-set or binding-registry entries should be handled under a current terminology/build-scope tracker.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy DSTU1 correction reporting that medication-package-form-codes did not differ from medication-form-codes, while package codes should include packaging/container concepts such as bottle, vial, and carton. The accepted resolution was to fix the Medication.package.container binding/value set so it included SNOMED CT codes where concept is-a 408102007.
initial_application: Historical commit 534313123abc479f1c95a22956d9992582f9743c explicitly lists 5892 and changed source/medication/valueset-medication-package-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT ancestor 284009009 to 408102007. The current retained value-set source still contains that 408102007 compose.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, but current source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml defines doseForm and packageSize, not Medication.package.container. Later FHIR-12347 reassessed the then-current container terminology, and GF #13879 removed Medication.package.container from Medication. Same-family audit commits for FHIR-5993, FHIR-7266, FHIR-7746, FHIR-8063, and FHIR-8066 are already present on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested package-form terminology expression is already present where the legacy value-set file remains, and there is no current Medication.package.container element or binding to correct.
